AccountUpdate.description: Partial. `name` cannot be cleared (sending null for it is invalid input).
AccountUpdate.title: AccountUpdate

AgingConfig.description: days_since = run date - a date column; `stagnant` when days_since > N on matching rows.
AgingConfig.title: AgingConfig

ChartConfig.description: The backend aggregates the points (numbers come from code); the browser only draws.
ChartConfig.title: ChartConfig

CompanyUpdate.description: Partial; an explicit null clears a field (except `name`).
CompanyUpdate.title: CompanyUpdate

Computed.description:
A computed column. add/sub/mul/div: left op right (division by zero gives null).
days_between: right - left in days (both date columns). bucket: cut `left` (a column) at
`edges` (ascending) into `labels` (len(edges) + 1).
Computed.title: Computed

ConnectionOut.description:
Never carries the password (nor whether it is sealed beyond `has_password`).

`sslmode=require` encrypts but does not verify the server certificate; for a remote host use
`verify-full` (needs a CA known to the server running DataForce). Use a read-only,
non-superuser database role: it is the real boundary.
ConnectionOut.title: ConnectionOut

ContactUpdate.description: Partial. The manager is changed with PUT .../reports-to (cycle and account checks).
ContactUpdate.title: ContactUpdate

DealStage.description: Fixed pipeline (custom pipelines are out of v1).
DealStage.title: DealStage

DealUpdate.description: Partial. The stage (and closed_on) is changed with PUT .../stage.
DealUpdate.title: DealUpdate

DedupConfig.description:
Fuzzy deduplication on one text column. Adds `dedup_group` and `is_master`. Never merges
CRM records.
DedupConfig.title: DedupConfig

DemoAiKeyOut.description: The visitor's session AI key. The key itself is never returned.
DemoAiKeyOut.title: DemoAiKeyOut

DemoStartIn.description: Who to be in the demo: "admin" (default) or the app_user id of a rep.
DemoStartIn.title: DemoStartIn

Dimension.description: Deal attributes the engine segments on. All categorical.
Dimension.title: Dimension

DomainConfig.description: Extract the domain of an email or URL and flag free webmail. No DNS lookup.
DomainConfig.title: DomainConfig

EffectFinding.description:
'Group X differs from the rest on metric M.'

Only `verified` findings may be shown as facts.
EffectFinding.title: EffectFinding

EngagementConfig.description:
Engagement per account: weighted activity counts in the last `window_days` days, times
(1 - penalty) when the latest touchpoint is more than `quiet_days` days old.
EngagementConfig.title: EngagementConfig

label.default: heuristic: a weighted count, not a verified measure
label.title: Label

ExplainMeasure.description:
A numeric column compared by median, or the share of rows where `column` equals
`success_value` (the win rate of a closed-deals outcome such as is_won).
ExplainMeasure.title: ExplainMeasure

FlowGraph.description:
Validated structurally here (ids unique, edges reference existing nodes and real ports,
one edge per input port, no cycle) so a stored graph is always runnable or explainable.
FlowGraph.title: FlowGraph

ForecastConfig.description: amount x stage probability (percent). The probabilities are the user's assumptions.
ForecastConfig.title: ForecastConfig

GateConfig.description:
Snapshot of the 'not verified' gates used for a result (from Settings).

Validated like Settings: a NaN or out-of-range threshold would make every gate pass.
GateConfig.title: GateConfig

MemberCreate.description: Create a person (display_name + password) or add an existing account (email only).
MemberCreate.title: MemberCreate

ModelConfig.description:
Fit on `train`, evaluate on `test`. Features: numeric columns are standardised, other
columns one-hot encoded (top 30 values, the rest grouped as "other").
ModelConfig.title: ModelConfig

ModelMetrics.description: What the block reported on held-out data (server-computed, never sent by the client).
ModelMetrics.title: ModelMetrics

Operand.description: A column or a constant (exactly one).
Operand.title: Operand

PipelineOut.description: Exact SQL aggregates (facts: no interval, no gate).
PipelineOut.title: PipelineOut

PostgresSource.description: Exactly one of `table` ("schema.table" or "table") and `query` (one SELECT statement).
PostgresSource.title: PostgresSource

PricingOut.description: Credits per lookup. Assumed from TamTam's public site until a real account confirms them.
PricingOut.title: PricingOut

RecordSource.description: Where a CRM row comes from. Third-party personal data always keeps its origin.
RecordSource.title: RecordSource

RegexConfig.description:
Apply a regular expression to one text column. Modes: extract (named groups become
columns), replace, match (boolean) and split (up to `split_into` columns). The pattern is
limited to 200 characters and checked for catastrophic backtracking (see blocks/regex.py).
RegexConfig.title: RegexConfig

ScoreConfig.description:
Apply a saved model's parameters to the input rows. Adds `score` (and `score_class` for a
classifier). The parameters are resolved from the workspace when the run starts.
ScoreConfig.title: ScoreConfig

StandardizeConfig.description:
Clean text columns by applying `operations` in order. A column is overwritten or gets a
`<col>_std` column. Nulls stay null. Pure text rules: no library, no network.
StandardizeConfig.title: StandardizeConfig

StatValue.description: One computed number with its uncertainty and its verification status.
StatValue.title: StatValue

StatsConfig.description:
Compare each group of `group_by` with the rest of the rows on `outcome`.
rate: share of rows where outcome == success_value (default True); median: numeric outcome.
Uses the workspace's gates (Wilson / Newcombe / Fisher or bootstrap / Mann-Whitney, BH).
StatsConfig.title: StatsConfig

TouchpointConfig.description: Rep touchpoint ratio = meetings x meeting_weight / outreach (outbound calls and emails).
TouchpointConfig.title: TouchpointConfig

VelocityConfig.description:
Deal velocity on stage-change events (deal_id, from_stage, to_stage, changed_at).
Each completed stay is ranked within the completed stays of the same stage; a deal's index is
the median of its stays' percentiles (0 = fastest, 1 = slowest). Fast track = at or below
`fast_track_pct`, stagnant = at or above `stagnant_pct`. A stage with fewer than
`min_stage_n` completed stays is "insufficient data".
VelocityConfig.title: VelocityConfig

WindowConfig.description:
A window function over partitions, ordered by one column. `period` first sums `column`
per partition and period (month, quarter or year of the order column).
WindowConfig.title: WindowConfig
